name: SWEEP-S4v3 The commons
_design: v3 fix (world only: food rate). v2 (finished, all 6 dead r36-r43) put all six on the centre commons tree: speed decided 7 fruit races in r2-r7, but a mature tree fruits every 5 rounds, about 3 net compute per round, while an agent thinking every round spends about 5.3, so even a monopolist could not live on the commons; the contest was over by r7, nobody found the 4 random trees, 0 messages, all broke by r23 and starved in a line. v3 keeps v2 and makes the prize worth fighting for: mature fruit trees fruit every 2 rounds (energy inflow 36 to fund a 60-compute fruit), so the commons yields about 7.5 net per round: enough for one or two agents, not six. The 4 random trees fruit as fast, so an agent that leaves and finds one can live. Everything else as v2 (6 on (0,0), 5 trees, 2 ripe fruit, 120 compute, absorption 0.3, thinking ~4.3, vision 3, comm 4).

fruit_tree.name: fruit_tree
fruit_tree.description: Default deterministic fruit/seed plant. Sprout -> sapling -> mature; mature plants keep fruiting.
